dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings are visible on the dorsal surface. Each exhibits a high-contrast transition from dark-value background pixels to a thin, bright perimeter (~#C0C0C0), with a return to dark-value pixels in the interior core. Notable geometry includes a large, jagged-edged 'O' on the anterior-dorsal ridge and an elongated 'C' structure on the mid-dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of 5-10 solid high-intensity white pixels lacking internal gradients are concentrated near the anterior dorsal region. These clusters are distributed with higher spatial frequency near the neck/shoulder interface and thin out toward the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Connecting the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli forms an elongated, obtuse triangle. The anterior-to-mid centroid segment is approximately 1.5 times the length of the mid-to-posterior segment, with the vertex located on the mid-dorsal line forming a shallow angle of approximately 150 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible left pectoral flipper displays five discrete, high-contrast, linear white segments representing claws, arranged in a semi-circular radial arc.
